exceptions.justification: This package was just scaffolded and has no Socket.dev API token yet, so the SecuritySocket scan cannot run in CI. The rest of the contract runs; the supply-chain score is unchecked until a token exists.
exceptions.ruleBroken: A check that could not run fails the CI gate unless a record says why that is acceptable.
exceptions.attempted: Nothing yet: the repository secret SOCKET_SECURITY_API_KEY has not been created.
exceptions.constraint: A Socket.dev token belongs to a person or an organization and cannot be scaffolded.
exceptions.whyPreferable: A red first CI run teaches an adopter the exception schema before it teaches them the package; a dated record teaches the decision instead.
exceptions.residualRisk: Alerts on this package's dependencies are not scored until a token exists; npm audit (SecurityDeps) still runs.
exceptions.revisitWhen: A SOCKET_SECURITY_API_KEY repository secret exists (then delete this record), or this record expires.
